messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Riley,

Walter Hewitt's leadership work across renewable infrastructure, energy transition platforms and senior executive appointments aligns closely with the intersection of ESG, institutional engagement and energy transition in my current portfolio.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and stakeholder governance around industrial renewable-energy investments.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy transition, responsible development, stakeholder trust and regulatory execution converge. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration. I would welcome discussion of relevant mandates across energy transition, infrastructure, ESG, external affairs, strategic partnerships and country leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
